limitations: Local benchmark and browser evidence are synthetic; hosted speed improvement has not been measured.
Prior resource pressure was observed before the last courier release; sole-cause attribution is not proven.
Concurrent workspace reads still prepare independent results; no speculative admission limiter was added.
No production database, provider, financial transaction, recovery, sync, backfill, or advertising write was exercised for this acceptance.
CodeQL no-new-alerts does not mean all pre-existing repository alerts are absent.
CI and an ordinary Git merge do not constitute a live publication or close another owner's release lease.
